There’s a market for bitcoin-aligned small business owners who need liquidity but would like an alternative to seeing their company gutted by PE.

Given the high bankruptcy rates of post-PE business (high leverage), and common complaints by communities (“this veterinarian clinic was awesome until PE took it over”), I think a more wholesome alternative is useful. Companies like Berkshire that buy businesses and let them keep running in the way that originally made them successful is proof of that, if you have a long time horizon.

From an investor perspective, I think combining a diverse set of cashflows with bitcoin makes sense. Any debt interest that exists can be kept as a modest percentage of operating cash flows, letting the company short fiat and go long bitcoin with an indefinite time horizon regardless of Bitcoin price (as long as business cashflows are properly maintained). Additionally, it gives options for counter-cyclical moves to lean into what’s cheap. Bitcoin is in a bear market and/or the business acquisition funnel encountered a soft patch? Then lean into buying more bitcoin. Bitcoin just went up 10x and the business acquisition funnel is strong? Then lean into buying more businesses.

美国参议院通过两党决议，反对赦免 SBF

美国参议院于7月15日通过 S.Res.772 决议，明确表示无论任何情况下，FTX 创始人 Sam Bankman-Fried 都不应获得总统赦免、减刑或其他形式的联邦宽赦。

决议由民主党参议员 Ruben Gallego 和共和党参议员 Cynthia Lummis 共同提出，并通过一致同意程序获批，没有参议员提出反对。决议还提到，正在服刑25年的 SBF 已于2026年正式提交总统赦免申请。

不过，这是一份表达参议院立场的非约束性决议，无法限制特朗普行使总统赦免权，也不代表参议院进行了100票对0票的记名表决。
